context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 73 tested HTML Newsletter Email Dispatch feature. Key findings: (1) dispatch_newsletter_for_post service works correctly with idempotency guard (email_dispatched_at). (2) Rate limiting: 5 emails per batch with 1.05s pause. (3) Auto-dispatch on publish works for both POST /api/news/posts and POST /api/news/posts/{id}/publish. (4) Manual send endpoint returns {queued:true, recipients} for async dispatch or {reason:'no_recipients'} synchronously. (5) Preview endpoint returns audience_count, channels, HTML preview. (6) Frontend NewsletterActions component shows only for moderators on published posts with email channel. (7) Resend sandbox rejects non-verified emails - this is EXPECTED behavior, not a bug. (8) Regression: Editorial Calendar, meeting mode-config, news push send all working.
